extraction.name: VAP-Data
extraction.description: The largest dataset for semantic-controlled video generation with over 100K paired videos across 100 semantic conditions.
extraction.creator: Yuxuan Bian, Xin Chen, Zenan Li, Tiancheng Zhi, Shen Sang, Linjie Luo, Qiang Xu
extraction.publisher: Intelligent Creation Lab, ByteDance, The Chinese University of Hong Kong
extraction.rai:dataCollection: Images were collected from the Internet and paired videos were generated using commercial Image-to-Video models and community LoRAs.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Web Scraping, Software Collection, Web API
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: High-quality reference images from the Internet and visual-effects templates from commercial models (VIDU and Kling) and community LoRAs.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: Paired videos were created by matching each collected image to all compatible Image-to-Video visual-effects templates.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Videos are resized to 480x720 (832) and sampled at 49 frames at 16 fps.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Standard video descriptions are used as captions for the reference and target videos to aid in finding and transferring shared semantic control signals.
extraction.rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Images spanning men, women, and children.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: Potential misuses include identity impersonation, deepfake content, targeted harassment, deceptive political messaging, and generation of sexualized or violent media.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The dataset may inherit specific stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations from the source templates used to generate it.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: The semantic conditions are relatively limited, synthetic, and derived from other generative models, which may inherit stylistic biases, artifacts, and conceptual limitations.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Intended for research, education, and creative prototyping. Not intended for surveillance, impersonation, political persuasion, or other high-risk deployments.
